definition_zh: 采集植物；考察植物；在野外研究植物
definition_en: to collect or study plants, especially in their wild habitat
core_image: 背着标本夹的植物学家俯身在山野草丛间，采下一株野花压进标本纸
scene: 暑假里他和同学结伴进山认药草。They hiked for a whole week through the valley to botanize among the alpine meadows.
sceneCN: 这里 botanize 是「采集、考察植物」（第 1 个义项：在野外收集植物）；句意是他们徒步一整周，在高山草甸间采集植物。

pos.zh: 采集并研究（某地的）植物

collocations.zh: 为寻找稀有物种而采集植物
整个夏天都在采集植物

derivatives.zh: 由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「植物采集考察」
由同根名词后缀构成，义为「植物学」
由同根加表人后缀构成，义为「植物学家」
由同根加形容词后缀构成，义为「植物学的」
同根形容词变体，义为「植物的」

senses.title: To collect plants in the wild
senses.definition: to search for and gather plants or plant specimens in natural surroundings
senses.definitionCN: 在自然环境中寻找并采集植物或植物标本
senses.example: The students spent the afternoon botanizing on the hillside.
senses.exampleCN: 学生们整个下午都在山坡上采集植物。
senses.why: The verb grew out of the noun botany, so its first job is the hands-on work a botanist does: going out and picking plants.
senses.whyCN: 这个词由名词 botany（植物学）动词化而来，最先指的正是植物学家的本职工作——走进野外动手采集植物。

senses.title: To study plants in their natural habitat
senses.definition: to observe and examine plants where they naturally grow
senses.definitionCN: 在植物自然生长的地方观察、研究它们
senses.example: She botanized in the rainforest for three months.
senses.exampleCN: 她在雨林里做了三个月的植物考察。
senses.why: Collecting naturally extends to observing the plant where it lives, since habitat is part of what a botanist studies.
senses.whyCN: 采集自然会延伸到在植物的原生地观察研究，因为生境本身就是植物学家的研究对象。

senses.title: To survey the plant life of a region
senses.definition: to explore an area systematically in order to record its plants
senses.definitionCN: 系统地走查一个地区，以记录那里的植物种类
senses.example: The expedition botanized the entire coastal range.
senses.exampleCN: 考察队踏查了整条沿海山脉的植物。
senses.why: Once collecting becomes systematic, the object widens from single plants to the plant life of a whole region.
senses.whyCN: 当采集变成系统性工作后，对象就从一株株植物扩大为整个地区的植物区系。

senses.title: To identify plants while walking about
senses.definition: to recognize and name the plants one meets on a walk
senses.definitionCN: 在行走途中辨认并说出所见植物的名称
senses.example: Grandmother botanized her way up the trail, naming every fern.
senses.exampleCN: 祖母一路辨认着植物上山，说出每种蕨类的名字。
senses.why: Naming what you pick is the inseparable companion of collecting, so identification becomes a sense of its own.
senses.whyCN: 辨认所采之物是采集不可分割的伴生动作，于是「辨认」独立成了一个义项。

senses.title: To press and preserve plant specimens
senses.definition: to prepare collected plants for study by drying and mounting them
senses.definitionCN: 把采到的植物干燥、装帧，制成可供研究的标本
senses.example: The interns botanized their findings into the herbarium collection.
senses.exampleCN: 实习生们把采集所得制成标本，存入植物标本馆。
senses.why: A collected plant only has scientific value once preserved, so the word stretches to cover the making of specimens.
senses.whyCN: 采下的植物只有经过保存才有科学价值，词义因此延伸到标本制作环节。

senses.title: To hunt for plants as a pastime
senses.definition: to wander about looking for flowers and plants for pleasure rather than science
senses.definitionCN: 出于爱好而非科研，闲逛着寻花觅草
senses.example: Retirees botanize the country lanes every spring.
senses.exampleCN: 退休的人们每年春天都在乡间小路上寻花觅草。
senses.why: Once the professional task becomes a hobby, the word loosens into leisurely plant-hunting.
senses.whyCN: 当这一职业动作变成爱好，词义便松弛为悠闲的寻花之旅。

senses.title: To gather knowledge or facts bit by bit
senses.definition: to collect information or ideas the way a botanist gathers plants
senses.definitionCN: 像植物学家采集植物那样，点滴收集信息或见解
senses.example: He botanized through old archives for traces of the recipe.
senses.exampleCN: 他在陈年档案里一点一点搜集那份食谱的痕迹。
senses.why: Because the core image is picking one specimen at a time, the verb is borrowed for gathering anything one item at a time.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是「一株一株地采」，因此这个动词被借来形容一切「一件一件收集」的行为。

senses.title: To take delight in plants
senses.definition: to find enjoyment in the company of plants
senses.example: All winter she dreamed of botanizing again among wild orchids.
senses.exampleCN: 一整个冬天她都盼着再去野兰花丛中流连。
senses.why: Pleasure in looking and gathering shades into affection for plants themselves, completing the sense from action to feeling.
senses.whyCN: 观与采的乐趣进一步沉淀为对草木本身的喜爱，词义由动作落到情感。

intro.en: Botanize is an English verb built on the Greek root botan- through the learned noun botany.
intro.cn: botanize 是以希腊语词根 botan- 经学术名词 botany（植物学）派生出的英语动词。

items.en: Greek botanē meant pasture, fodder, or herb, a noun formed on the verb boskein, to feed or graze.
items.cn: 希腊语 botanē 意为「牧草、饲料、草本植物」，源自动词 boskein（放牧、喂养）。

items.en: In Hellenistic Greek the plural botanai came to denote herbs and plants as objects of study.
items.cn: 在希腊化时期，其复数形式 botanai 已用来指作为研究对象的草木。

items.en: Medieval Latin borrowed the Greek word as botanica for the science of plants.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语将该希腊词借为 botanica，指植物之学。

items.en: French developed botanique, the learned adjective and field name, in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 十七世纪法语形成 botanique，作为学术用语的形容词与学科名。

items.en: English took over botany from the French noun, first written botanique and botanie.
items.cn: 英语自法语借入 botany，早期拼写有 botanique、botanie 等形式。

items.en: The verb botanize appeared in the eighteenth century, attaching the productive suffix -ize to the science name.
items.cn: 十八世纪出现动词 botanize，即在学科名后接能产性后缀 -ize 构成。

note.en: The botan- family is small and clean; the nearest verbs all share the idea of going out and gathering.
note.cn: botan- 词族小而清晰；语义最近的动词都带有「走出去采集」的意思。

entries.definitionCN: 植物学；botanize 的词源基础
植物学家；botanize 的主体人物

entries.definition: relating to plants, as in botanic garden
entries.definitionCN: 植物的；如 botanic garden（植物园）

entries.definition: British spelling of the same verb
to search widely for food or supplies
entries.definitionCN: 四处搜寻食物或物资；与 botanize 的「采集」义相近但对象不同

entries.definition: to bring together things scattered or growing
entries.definitionCN: 采集、收拢；泛指收集，botanize 特指植物

entries.definition: to bring together items as a set or for study
entries.definitionCN: 收集、集藏；botanize 可视为其植物学特例

normalIntro.en: Hold on to the family: botany, botanist, botanical, and the verb simply adds the -ize ending.
normalIntro.cn: 抓住词族：botany、botanist、botanical，动词不过是再加上 -ize。

normal.en: botan- is the Greek root for herb and pasture, seen in botany.
normal.cn: botan- 是希腊词根「草、牧草」，见于 botany。

normal.en: -ize turns a field of study into an activity, as in memorize.
normal.cn: -ize 把学科变成动作，如 memorize（记忆）。

normal.en: botanist is the doer; botanize is the doing.
normal.cn: botanist 是人，botanize 是这个人做的事。

normal.en: botanical garden is where one goes to botanize politely.
normal.cn: botanical garden（植物园）正是规规矩矩 botanize 的场所。

normal.en: British writing may spell it botanise with -ise.
normal.cn: 英式写作中可拼作 botanise。

abstract.en: Picture a collector pressing one flower at a time into a folder.
abstract.cn: 想象采集者把花一株一株压进标本夹。

abstract.en: Each new fact you note is a specimen for your mental herbarium.
abstract.cn: 你记下的每条新知，都是脑内标本馆里的一份标本。

abstract.en: Wander, stoop, pick, press: the rhythm of the word is the rhythm of the work.
abstract.cn: 走、俯、采、压：这个词的节奏就是这活儿的节奏。

examples.en: In August the team botanized the alpine meadows for rare gentians.
examples.cn: 八月，考察队在高山草甸间采集稀有的龙胆属植物。

examples.en: She learned more botanizing for a weekend than in a month of lectures.
examples.cn: 她周末出去考察植物两天，比听一个月的课收获还多。

examples.en: The herbarium grew rapidly because so many graduates went botanizing that summer.
examples.cn: 那年夏天许多毕业生外出采集植物，标本馆的馆藏因此大增。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「啵特奈兹」——看见特别的植物就「啵」地一下采下来，特（别）奈（不得）之下还得再（兹）采一株：这就是 botanize 的画面。

root: 希腊语词根 botan-（草、牧草，出自 botanē「牧草」）+ 动词后缀 -ize；与拉丁语 bos（牛）所属的「放牧」语义场一般认为同出一源，存疑处仅在于更早的重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: From the literal gathering of plants, the senses widen to surveying, identifying, preserving, and finally to figurative collecting of knowledge.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从字面的采集植物出发，扩展到踏查、辨认、制标本，最后引申为对知识的点滴搜集。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: stooping in the field to gather plants one by one
core.cn: 核心意象：在野外俯身，一株一株地采集植物

branches.en: hand and folder: picking and pressing specimens
branches.cn: 手与标本夹：采集与压制标本

branches.en: eye and name: observing and identifying in habitat
branches.cn: 眼与名：在生境中观察并辨认

branches.en: map and route: surveying a whole region's flora
branches.cn: 地图与路线：踏查一地植物区系

branches.en: leisure path: hunting plants for pleasure
branches.cn: 休闲之径：以寻花觅草为乐

branches.en: mind garden: collecting knowledge, cherishing plants
branches.cn: 心之园圃：采撷知识、珍爱草木

intro.en: The word is a clean root-plus-suffix formation; most of its family shares the single Greek root botan-.
intro.cn: 这个词是典型的「词根＋后缀」构词；其词族大多共享希腊词根 botan-。

latinIntro.en: There are no Latin cognates inside the botan- family; the learned medieval Latin form was itself borrowed from Greek.
latinIntro.cn: botan- 词族内部没有拉丁同源词；中世纪拉丁语形式本身就是从希腊语借入的。

botany 指植物学这门学科

biology（生物学）由「生命」与「学」构成
